lists.name: Barrier Law
specialNotes: All “Wall” spells created by spells on this list must rest (i.e., stand) on a solid surface.
All “Wall” spells require that at least 1 cubic foot of the material that the wall consists of be within 50' of the caster.

With all walls, the caster has the option of varying the width and height (not the thickness) up to the allowed dimensions. If the caster is attempting to “fill” a space with the wall, the wall will not fit perfectly (i.e., not snug).
See Appendix A-9.17.7 (p. 205) for more on walls.

spells.name: Light Wall I
spells.description: Creates a black, insubstantial wall up to 20' x 20' x 1" that light cannot pass into or through (i.e., it does not hinder movement, but it blocks vision).

spells.name: Airwall
spells.description: Creates a wall of dense churning air up to 10' x 10' x 3'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 50%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty.

spells.name: Light Wall II
spells.description: As Light Wall I, except for duration.

spells.name: Waterwall
spells.description: Creates a wall of water up to 10' x 10' x 1'. This wall reduces all movement through it by 80%. In addition, all attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty.

spells.name: Woodwall
spells.description: Creates a wall of wood up to 10' x 20' x 2". This wall can be burned through, chopped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

spells.name: Earthwall
spells.description: As Woodwall, except wall is made of earth and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (3' at base, 1' at top) of packed earth.

spells.name: Icewall I
spells.description: As Woodwall, except wall is made of ice and has a size up to 10' x 10' x (2' at base, 1' at top). It can be melted, chipped through, or toppled (if not propped up somehow).

spells.name: Barrier Pit
spells.description: Opens a pit (500 cubic feet in stone; 1000 cubic feet in earth or ice). The entire pit must be within 50' of caster. A pit may not be opened except on a horizontal surface with an incline of less than 45°.

lists.name: Concussion's Ways
specialNotes: See Section 24.1 (p. 75) for more on healing.

spells.name: Healing I
spells.description: Target is healed of d10 concussion hits.

spells.name: Frost/Burn Relief I
spells.description: Target is healed of one area of up to mild frostbite or 1st degree burn.

spells.name: Minor Irritation Relief
spells.description: Target is healed of one minor irritation (e.g., headache, toothache, bee-sting, hangover, etc.).

spells.name: Healing III
spells.description: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 3d10 concussion hits.

spells.name: Stun Relief
spells.description: Target is relieved of 1 round's worth of accumulated stun effects.

spells.name: Frost/Burn Relief II
spells.description: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 2 areas of mild damage or 1 area of moderate damage (e.g., 2nd degree burn).

spells.name: Regeneration I
spells.description: Will reduce damage target has by 1 hit every minute as long as caster concentrates. If the caster is unconscious this spell will operate on him without concentration.

spells.name: Healing V
spells.description: As Healing I, except that target is healed of 5d10 concussion hits.

spells.name: Frost/Burn Relief III
spells.description: As Frost/Burn Relief I, except caster can heal 3 areas of mild damage or 1 area of severe damage (e.g., 3rd degree burn) or a combination of 1 mild and 1 moderate area of damage.

spells.name: Awakening
spells.description: Target is instantly awake.

lists.name: Detection Mastery
specialNotes: All of the spells on this list are Passive in type. The target of the spell is allowed an RR, but success only indicates that the target is aware that a spell was cast upon him (i.e., the spell still works).
A “curse” (for the purposes of the Detect Curse spell) is defined as something that is detrimental and magical in nature (e.g., delivered from the Curses spell list).

spells.name: Detect Channeling
spells.description: Detects any active spell or item from the Channeling realm; caster can concentrate on a different 5 foot radius each round.

spells.name: Detect Essence
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except realm is Essence.

spells.name: Detect Mentalism
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except realm is Mentalism.

spells.name: Detect Life
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except detects living beings.

spells.name: Detect Curse
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except detects curses on people or things.

spells.name: Detect Undead
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except detects the presence of Undead.

spells.name: Detect Traps
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except it gives a 75% chance of detecting a trap (trap sophistication modifiers may reduce or enhance this chance).

spells.name: Life Typing
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except it analyzes one living being; giving race, age, and current state of health.

spells.name: Detect Invisible
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except detects invisible things. All attacks against an invisible target suffer a -50 penalty (instead of the standard -100).

spells.name: Perceive Power I
spells.description: As Detect Channeling, except it will give an estimate of the power (i.e., level) of the person, item, or spell examined.

lists.name: Light's Way
specialNotes: None of the Aura spells (Aura and True Aura) are cumulative with each other.

spells.name: Projected Light
spells.description: A beam of light (like a flashlight) springs from the caster's palm; 50' effective range. If the caster closes his fist, the light will “turn off;” when the fist is opened, the light will come back on (so long as the spell duration has not expired).

spells.name: Light I
spells.description: Lights a 10 foot radius area about the point touched; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being.

spells.name: Aura
spells.description: Creates a bright aura about the target, making him appear more powerful and subtracting 10 from all attacks against the target.

spells.name: Light II
spells.description: As Light I, except 1 or 2 areas can be created with a total radius of 20' (e.g., one area of 20' or two areas of 10').

spells.name: Sudden Light
spells.description: Causes a 10 foot radius burst of intense light, all within are stunned for 1 round per 10 failure.

spells.name: True Aura
spells.description: As Aura, except it makes him appear very powerful; subtracting 15 from all attacks against the target.

spells.name: Shock Bolt
spells.description: A bolt of intense, charged light is shot from the palm of the caster; results are determined on the Bolt Spell Attack Table A-10.9.9 (p. 228).

spells.name: Light III
spells.description: As Light II, up to 3 areas can be created with a total radius of 30'.

spells.name: Utterlight I
spells.description: As Light I, except it is the equivalent of full daylight; it also nullifies all magically created darkness for the duration.

spells.name: Waiting Light
spells.description: As Light I, except caster can delay the spell up to 24 hours; it can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster): elapsed time, specific movements, specific sounds, or touch.

lists.name: Lofty Movements
specialNotes: See Appendix 9.17.6 (p. 205) for notes on encumbrance limits for movement spells.

spells.name: Edgewalking
spells.description: Target can walk along narrow edges (down to 2" wide) that can support his weight. Maneuver rolls are not normally required.

spells.name: Limbwalking
spells.description: Target can walk along tree limbs as if he were on level ground.

spells.name: Stonewalking
spells.description: Target can walk on stone surfaces of up to 60° as if he were on level ground.

spells.name: Waterwalking
spells.description: Target can walk on water as if he were on level ground; may not be used on rough water.

spells.name: Merging Organic
spells.description: Target can merge into organic material (live or dead). While merged, the target cannot move or perceive. When the target emerges from the material, he can emerge from any side or face of the material. The target cannot move “through” material greater in width than his own body size plus 2 feet.

spells.name: Store Sanctuary
spells.description: Caster “stores” a location for use with certain spells above 10th level (see Spell Law). While casting this spell, the caster must meditate for one hour in the location that will be stored. The caster can only have one sanctuary stored at a time. As long as this location remains “stored,” it will detect as a magical (i.e., “holy”) place.

spells.name: Limbrunning
spells.description: As Limbwalking, except target can run.

spells.name: Stonerunning
spells.description: As Stonewalking, except target can run.

lists.name: Nature's Law
specialNotes: Any spell that provides information to the caster can be tricky for the GM to run. Every GM should examine lore spells and determine how much information he is willing to impart to the players. See Appendix A-9.17.13 (p. 206) for more on information spells.
An herb is defined as a plant that, when specially prepared, provides some unusual benefit to the user. This does not apply to poisons.

spells.name: Plant Lore
spells.description: Caster learns nature, history, and value of any 1 plant.

spells.name: Herb Lore
spells.description: Caster can understand the nature, origin, and value of any 1 herb; if the plant is not an herb, no information will be related.

spells.name: Stone Lore
spells.description: Caster learns the nature, history, and origin of any 1 stone.

spells.name: Speed Growth
spells.description: Caster can increase speed of growth for any 1 species of plant within the radius by 10 times.

spells.name: Animal Tongues
spells.description: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any 1 animal species.

spells.name: Animal Mastery I
spells.description: Caster can control the actions of any 1 animal.

spells.name: Nature's Awareness I
spells.description: Caster can monitor animate activity in the area (e.g., he will be aware of subtle movements). For the duration of the spell, the caster cannot move.

spells.name: Disease Purification
spells.description: Stops infection and/or spread of a disease in 1 target after he has acquired the disease. No further damage will occur in uninfected areas of the body.

spells.name: Food Preservation
spells.description: This spell perfectly preserves one day's worth of food for 1 week, after which it will spoil normally.

spells.name: Poison Purification
spells.description: Neutralizes any 1 poison in the system of 1 target. Damage already sustained is not cured.

spells.name: Disease Resistance I
spells.description: For the duration of the spell, target gets an additional RR versus any disease(s).

spells.name: Poison Resistance I
spells.description: For the duration of the spell, target gets an additional RR versus any poison(s).

spells.name: Sustenance Purification
spells.description: This spell neutralizes abnormal diseases, poison, and other similar substances in one day's worth of food and/or water. It will not neutralize a poison or similar substance that is a natural part of the food (e.g., it will not neutralize the natural poison in poisoned mushrooms).

spells.name: Disease Resistance II
spells.description: As Disease Resistance I, except target gets 2 additional RRs.

spells.name: Poison Resistance II
spells.description: As Poison Resistance I, except target gets 2 additional RRs.

spells.name: Mind Disease Cures
spells.description: Target is cured of any 1 mind disease, recovery 1-50 days.

spells.name: Speech I
spells.description: Target is able to communicate basic ideas in the language of a specific being (e.g., hungry, thirsty, bathroom, peace, etc.). For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 2 in the language.

spells.name: Quiet I
spells.description: Creates a 1 foot radius area around the target, into and out of which sound cannot travel; if the point is on a mobile object or being, it will move with the object/being. +25 to any Stalking maneuvers.

spells.name: Soundwall I
spells.description: Creates a plane (up to 20' x 20'), through which sound will not pass.

spells.name: Speech II
spells.description: As Speech I, except target can communicate in more complex concepts, although there is a good chance of misinterpretations. For the duration of the spell, the target has the equivalent of skill rank 4 in the language.

spells.name: Silence I
spells.description: As Quiet I, except radius is 10'.

spells.name: Quiet III
spells.description: As Quiet I, except 3 targets can be affected.

spells.name: Soundwall V
spells.description: As Soundwall I, except 5 such walls are created. Each Soundwall must be connected to at least one other Soundwall.

spells.name: Protection I
spells.description: Subtracts 5 from elemental attack rolls against the target, and adds 5 to all of the target's RRs versus spells.

spells.name: Cancel Channeling
spells.description: When the caster of this spell is a target of a spell from the realm of Channeling, the “incoming” spell must first make an RR before the caster makes an RR. For RR purposes, each spell uses a level equal to its caster's level. If the “incoming” spell passes the RR, it may target the caster of this spell normally; otherwise the incoming spell has no effect on this target.

spells.name: Protection Sphere I
spells.description: As Protection I, except for duration and all beings within 10' of target get the benefits.

spells.name: Cancel Essence
spells.description: As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm of Essence.

spells.name: Protection II
spells.description: As Protection I, except bonuses are 10.

spells.name: Cancel Mentalism
spells.description: As Cancel Channeling, except the caster is protected from spells in the realm of Mentalism.

spells.name: Protection Sphere II
spells.description: As Protection Sphere I, except bonuses are 10.

spells.name: Dispel Channeling I
spells.description: Any active spell from the realm of Channeling that is on the target must make an RR (use the level of that spell's caster as the spell's level). If the spell fails its RR, it is dispelled.

spells.name: Channeling Shield
spells.description: Creates a shimmering shield in front of the caster. This shield subtracts 10 from all frontal Channeling attack rolls on the caster (base and elemental). In addition, if the caster performs no other actions during a round, he can “parry” (as with a normal shield) one spell attack. The parry bonus is equal to 10 plus the caster's skill rank with this list.

spells.name: Protection III
spells.description: As Protection I, except bonuses are 15.

lists.name: Weather Ways
specialNotes: All weather generating spells cause weather to gradually form over a period of one minute. In addition, weather generating spells have no effect in areas where there are not normally occurring weather patterns (i.e., inside buildings, etc.).
See App. A-9.17.13 (p. 206) for more on information spells.

spells.name: Living Gauge
spells.description: Caster can ascertain information from the surrounding atmosphere. Information that may be gained includes: temperature, humidity, barometric pressure, and wind speed. The caster can gain a different piece of information each round.

spells.name: Rain Prediction
spells.description: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time and type of precipitation (±15 min.) over the next 24 hr. period.

spells.name: Storm Prediction
spells.description: As Rain Prediction, except it allows a 95% chance of predicting the time and type of a storm, ±15 minutes over the next 24 hour period.

spells.name: Weather Prediction I
spells.description: As Rain Prediction except it allows 95% chance of predicting time, type, and severity of weather (±15 minutes) over the next 24 hour period.

spells.name: Breeze Call
spells.description: Caster causes a breeze to come forth that will drive out any gaseous matter (cloud, etc.) and modifies by -10 all missile attacks entering, exiting, or passing through the area of effect. Once set, the direction of the breeze will not change.

spells.name: Fog Call
spells.description: Caster causes fog to arise that obscures all vision in and through the radius. All missile attacks into or out of the fog are modified by -10 to -50 (GM's discretion). See Appendix A-9.17.12 (p. 206) for more on fog.

spells.name: Weather Prediction III
spells.description: As Weather Prediction I, except that caster has a 95% chance of predicting weather over a 3 day period.
